messages:
marie: FYI - Founder Club applicant (NovaLeap) asking for an extended free credits package. POC kicks off Monday and they want credits to cover load/embedding stage + a short production pilot. Can we fast-track?
samir: Do we have expected token/embedding volume? rough numbers will help deal desk size it. Also: which models/regions?
marie: They plan to run embedding-heavy indexing + chat rerank. Estimate: ~250k tokens/week + 1M embedding units over 30 days. US-west region, using gpt-style open model in our catalog.
alex-salesops: Our standard Founder Club is $5k / 90d. Anything above needs Deal Desk approval (and finance sign-off). If they need load testing + pilot, ask to clarify commitment path (e.g., convert to a monthly commit after trial).
claire-cs: POC scope: index 50M docs sharded, run similarity search + reranking for demo queries. We need staging keys + prefix kv caching enabled. They want to run stress test Thurs-Fri.
dealbot: Credit request DD-4532 created and routed to #deal-desk queue. Attachments: NovaLeap_Security_SSQ.pdf (uploaded).
emily-legal: Quick read: SSQ has a question on data retention + export. They asked for a 6mo retention exemption in the POC. We should avoid exceptions without an addendum. If we grant more credits, require a short MSA addendum limiting retention and adding audit right.
samir: Quick cost calc: ```
# rough
tokens_per_week = 250000
weeks = 4
token_cost_per_1k = 0.003  # example
est_token_cost = tokens_per_week * weeks / 1000 * token_cost_per_1k
embeddings = 1000000
embedding_unit_cost = 0.0001
est_embedding_cost = embeddings * embedding_unit_cost
est_total = est_token_cost + est_embedding_cost
```

samir: Plugging numbers gives ~ $30-$60 for tokens + $100 for embeddings — but infra spike + indexing costs drive operational needs (GPU hours) so credits need to cover more than just unit cost.
marie: Right — they explicitly asked for $15k to run the full indexing + 30-day demo. We'd rather offer something in the middle and tie to a commit. Can Deal Desk approve a one-off $10k / 60d with clause: convert X% to committed usage if they go PROD?
alex-salesops: @olivia-dealdesk can you advise? If deal desk approves $10k, we need Finance to accept promo exposure. Also add the legal addendum Emily mentioned.
olivia-dealdesk: I can approve a partial promo here. Proposal: approve $10,000 in free credits, valid 60 days, explicit clause: credits expire if no commit >= $1k/mo for 3 consecutive months within 90 days of trial end. Require MSA addendum for retention + SOC2 notice. Please confirm staging key & support SLA.
marie: That would unblock the POC — thanks @olivia-dealdesk. Can we get keys + quota change today?
claire-cs: I can provision staging keys once Alex confirms the quota update. Will tag infra-oncall if we need burst GPUs.
alex-salesops: Done — quota ticket opened (INF-7890). @ops-bot please prioritize for Thursday stress window.
dealbot: Ticket INF-7890 acknowledged and scheduled. ETA: 48h.
emily-legal: I'll draft the MSA addendum and ping NovaLeap legal. Quick note: no retention exception over 180 days without Security team's sign-off.
marie: Great — moving forward. Final ask: @olivia-dealdesk to add the approval in the dealsheet so AE can close the trial terms. :thumbsup:
olivia-dealdesk: Added approval to dealsheet, noted MSA addendum required. Marking as escalated->approved. :rocket:
marie: Thanks everyone — will update NovaLeap and schedule kickoff.
